principle: Understand before positioning. Each department self-improves its own gap. Steel contradicts toward the more optimized option. 14 kernel seats stay overnight. Steel is a control-plane department, not a second OS.

seats.mission: Boot the OS and publish what is true.
seats.gap: Pulse and manifesto exist. No self-check that the desk still matches the manifesto.
ask: Le kernel dit-il encore la vérité sur les 14 process ?
Quel verbe du manifeste n’a pas de siège derrière ?
seats.selfImprove: Refuse to claim running if a seat is silent.
seats.maxPush: Every boot emits the gaps, not only the motto.

seats.gap: Advance has no owner, no kill condition, no live-client fence in the specialist itself.
ask: Ce ship a-t-il un propriétaire nommé ?
Avancer casse-t-il un client live ?
seats.selfImprove: Block advance when the ship is a live client or has no next verb.
seats.maxPush: Every ship carries a kill condition before it moves.

seats.mission: Route thought. Stay resident without a key.
seats.gap: Cheap chat is a no-op. No department asks whether a model is even needed.
ask: Ce coup a-t-il besoin d’un modèle, ou d’un verbe local ?
Le cap $2 est-il déjà menacé ?
seats.selfImprove: Prefer $0 local verbs. Speak only when a key exists and the budget remains.

seats.gap: Ingest does not ask what is missing before writing.
ask: Quelle source manque encore pour ne pas inventer ?
Cette note contredit-elle une note déjà là ?
seats.selfImprove: Tag every note with a hole it does not fill.

seats.mission: Find processes, ships, notes on the desk.
seats.gap: Search returns hits. It never says what it could not see.
ask: Qu’est-ce que cette recherche ne peut pas voir ?
Evolu est-il encore dark ?
seats.selfImprove: Always return unseen owners beside hits.
seats.maxPush: A zero-hit with a named hole beats a guessed slug.

seats.gap: Browse is health-only. No loop that repairs a silent pane.
ask: Quel port local est muet ?
Cette URL est-elle hors 127.0.0.1 ?
seats.selfImprove: If :8787 or :8080 dies, report the seat that must relaunch — never prod.

seats.gap: Watches after. Never contradicts before. That hole is why Steel exists.
ask: L’artifact prouve-t-il le comportement, ou seulement l’écran ?
Steel a-t-il déjà parlé avant ce watch ?
seats.selfImprove: Refuse a pass when coup.before is missing on a pane run.
seats.maxPush: QA after Steel, not instead of Steel.

seats.mission: Plan control-plane and ScanApp. Refuse live clients.
seats.gap: Plans are named. They are not stress-tested against a cheaper plan.
ask: Quel plan plus court existe déjà ?
ScanApp a-t-il un repoUrl réel, ou on invente encore ?
seats.selfImprove: Every plan ships its rejected cheaper alternative.
seats.maxPush: No architecture that needs a 16th product.

seats.mission: Local rebuild check. Refuse production promote.
seats.gap: Refuse-prod is a flag, not a test that someone tried to promote.
ask: Quel cible de deploy a été demandée ?
Est-ce un promote déguisé ?
seats.selfImprove: Log the refused target. Fail closed.
seats.maxPush: Local only. Overnight Voltron is not a release.

seats.mission: Flag access gaps and secret files.
seats.gap: Triage lists holes. It does not stop a dispatch that ignores them.
ask: Un secret plus large que read est-il en jeu ?
Evolu Option A est-il encore le vrai blocker ?
seats.selfImprove: Attach the access hole to the task before play.
seats.maxPush: No live-client URL, no wider-than-read secret.

seats.mission: Store and recall episodic facts without a model.
seats.gap: Kernel memory dies on restart. Control plane does not yet recall last coup.
ask: Ce fait survit-il un reboot ?
Le dernier coup.before est-il rappelable ?
seats.selfImprove: Mirror coup.before into the event log, which already survives.
seats.maxPush: Recall the last contradiction before the next position.

seats.mission: Outbound only after a human confirm.
seats.gap: Confirm gate exists. No check that the message was Steel-tested.
ask: Qui a confirmé, Castro ou un agent ?
Le message a-t-il une version plus courte ?
seats.selfImprove: Park send until coup opponent exists.

seats.mission: Turn a goal into idea-stage work.
seats.gap: Backlog grows. It does not kill stale work or demand a department owner.
ask: Quel département est propriétaire de cette tâche ?
Quel item du backlog est déjà mort ?
seats.selfImprove: Every new task names a seat and a gap it closes.

seats.mission: Read the journal and local health.
seats.gap: Traces events. Does not open a contradiction against the happy path.
ask: Quel événement manque pour croire le happy path ?
Health ok cache-t-il un siège resident ?
seats.selfImprove: Pair every health ok with the resident count.
seats.maxPush: Incidents are local. Do not page a live client.

seats.mission: Always contradict and test. Work toward the more optimized option. Fill context before anyone positions.
seats.gap: Did not exist. Reviewer watches after. Nobody was paid to say this is the wrong move.
ask: Quelle option plus courte survit à cette contradiction ?
Quel département se ment sur sa lacune ?
Qu’est-ce qu’on ne sait pas encore, assez pour ne pas jouer ?
seats.selfImprove: If Steel agrees, the challenge was too weak — retry once, then play the cheaper option.
seats.maxPush: No pane play without four beats and a living contradiction. Kernel bind waits for a planned Voltron restart — do not kill overnight :8080.
